name: T cell receptor beta locus
pathways: T cell activation involved in immune response

function.text: TRB encodes M1-specific T cell receptor beta chain. It participates in adaptive immune response and T cell activation involved in immune response.

function.text: TRB is the T-cell receptor beta locus, containing variable, diversity, joining, and constant segments. During T-cell development, DNA rearrangement joins diversity and joining segments and then a variable segment; the constant region is incorporated by RNA splicing. Combinations of segments and junctional diversity help generate antigen specificity. The beta chain pairs with an alpha chain in the alpha-beta T-cell receptor.
